title: Narrowband sensor reports a contact on every narrowband target regardless of ...
description: detectThis calls super.detectThis (sonar-equation gate) only when hasBearing is true (L322-L323); then, whenever the target has a NarrowbandRadNoise medium, it creates a DetectionEvent if res is null (L332-L336) and attaches a Doppler frequency. Consequently a target that failed the signal-excess test (or when HasBearing=false) is still reported as detected, at any range, with course and speed. The propagation-loss/steady-array gating is bypassed for all narrowband contacts. (Lines re-read by the merging reviewer; the code matches the description.)
trigger_input: Scenario with a NarrowbandSensor on ownship and a target with NarrowbandRadNoise placed 500 nm away: a detection with frequency is produced every scan even though super.detectThis returns null.
suggested_fix: Only create the frequency-only event when the SNR gate passed (e.g. compute a boolean 'detected' from super.detectThis or re-run the SE calculation when hasBearing is false); never fabricate a detection when res==null because SE<=0.
llm_value: Needs reading the control flow of the override against the base-class contract; nothing greppable.

title: getSelfNoiseFor() always returns 0: own-ship self noise ignored by all passiv...
description: getSelfNoiseFor declares 'final double res = 0', calls selfNoise.radiatedEnergyFor(...) and discards the result, so every caller (BroadbandSensor.getOSNoise L252, NarrowbandSensor L458, ActiveBroadbandSensor L217) feeds 0 dB own-ship noise into the passive sonar equation in InitialSensor.detectThis L177. Self noise configured via setSelfNoise/RadiatedCharacteristics has no effect, so signal excess and detection ranges are silently over-estimated for every participant that has a self-noise model. (Lines re-read by the merging reviewer; the code matches the description.)
trigger_input: Any scenario with a participant that has SelfNoise radiated characteristics and a Broadband/Narrowband sensor: detection range is identical whether self noise is 15 dB or 150 dB (see BBSensorTest.testHeloDetection L88-L99 which sets ff self noise 15).
suggested_fix: Return the value: 'res = selfNoise.radiatedEnergyFor(medium, status, brg_degs);' (drop the final).
llm_value: Requires noticing that a computed value is discarded and tracing the callers into the sonar equation; a linter would flag unused result only if configured.

title: Monte-Carlo scenario/control document parsing allows external entities
description: createNewBuilder() configures namespace awareness and a schema-language attribute but never disables doctype/external entities or enables FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING; readDocumentFrom() parses the user-supplied scenario template and control file with it. The generated documents are later serialised and written to disk, so entity content (e.g. a local file) is also persisted into the output scenarios.
trigger_input: ASSET control file with <!DOCTYPE ScenarioController [<!ENTITY f SYSTEM "file:///C:/Users/analyst/.ssh/id_rsa">]> and an attribute value &f;
suggested_fix: Harden the factory (secure processing, disallow-doctype-decl, no external entities, no XInclude) in createNewBuilder().
llm_value: grep-able

title: Output directory and file names for generated scenarios come from untrusted XML
description: setVariances() takes the OutputDirectory attribute of the ScenarioController element straight from the control file; MultiScenarioPresenter only remaps it when isRelativePath() is true, so an absolute path is honoured. writeTheseToFile() then mkdirs() that directory, writes control_file.xml there and writes each scenario to getDirectory()+'/'+id+'/'+scen_name+'.xml' where scen_name is the Name attribute from the scenario template, unescaped, so '../../' sequences escape the directory. RecordToFileObserverType observers are also pointed at the same directory. A crafted control+template pair thus writes attacker-influenced XML anywhere the user can write. || writeTheseToFile builds the output path from the scenario's Name attribute without sanitising (theDir + scen_name + '.xml', L1039); a template whose Scenario Name is '../../evil' writes outside the output directory. With deleteExisting=true it also recursively deletes getDirectory() (L991), a path taken from the control file's OutputDirectory attribute (setVariances L968-L972) unless overridden. Both are untrusted data-file inputs to the Monte-Carlo generator.
trigger_input: Control file <ScenarioController OutputDirectory="C:/Users/analyst/Startup"> plus a template whose Scenario Name="../../evil"
suggested_fix: Require the output directory to be chosen through the UI or restricted to the workspace; sanitise scen_name to a safe basename and verify the canonical path stays inside the output directory.
llm_value: Needed to trace the attribute from the SAX handler through ResultsContainer, the presenter's relative-path check and into the file writer.

title: EventReport PDU variableDatumLength drives byte[] allocation and iterator wit...
description: handleEvent takes variableDatumLength straight from the UDP packet (VariableDatum.unmarshal reads it with readInt, so it can be negative or up to 2^31-1) and does `new byte[thisLen]` (L271-L272), then iterates thisLen times calling iter.next() on the chunk list (L275-L276). Because VariableDatum.unmarshal stops filling variableData at EOF and swallows the exception, chunks.size() is normally far smaller than thisLen: a 2 GB length gives OutOfMemoryError, a negative length gives NegativeArraySizeException, and any length larger than the remaining packet gives NoSuchElementException. All escape logPDU into NetworkDISProvider.startListening, whose catch is outside the receive loop (L288), so the DIS listener thread dies after one packet.
trigger_input: Single 8 KB multicast datagram: PDU type 21 (EventReport), numberOfVariableDatumRecords=1, variableDatumLength=0x7FFFFFFF (or 0xFFFFFFFF) sent to the configured DIS group/port.
suggested_fix: Clamp thisLen to chunks.size() (and to a sane max, e.g. 64 KB), treat DIS datum length as bits (divide by 8) per IEEE 1278.1, and iterate over the chunk list rather than the declared length.
llm_value: Requires combining the swallowed-EOF behaviour in VariableDatum.unmarshal with the trusting loop in DISModule and the catch placement in NetworkDISProvider.

title: Any exception from one PDU permanently kills the DIS receive loop
description: startListening wraps the entire `while (_running)` loop in a single try (L241-L289); the generic catch at L288 sits outside the loop, so an exception thrown while parsing or dispatching ONE datagram (see DISModule row, or any listener bug) ends the loop, the socket is closed in finally and the view keeps showing it is connected while no further PDUs are processed. Real type: missing per-packet error isolation (robustness/DoS).
trigger_input: Any malformed EventReport PDU (see DISModule row) or a listener throwing on unexpected entity id.
suggested_fix: Move the try/catch inside the while loop so a bad packet is logged and skipped; only exit on SocketException when !_running.
llm_value: Simple structurally but only visible by reading loop/try nesting.

title: doTurn() computes height delta from stale demHeight field of previous partici...
description: doTurn (climb-rate branch) computes 'heightDelta = demHeight - (-depth)' at L1039 using the instance field demHeight, which is only assigned inside doTurn2 (L1132) during the previous call. Because CoreMovement holds one static TurnAlgorithm shared by all participants (CoreMovement L214), demHeight belongs to whichever participant moved last. The climb/dive phase (L1048-L1077) is therefore triggered with the wrong magnitude and sign, so helicopter/aircraft height changes are mis-timed and the default climb/dive speed is applied for the wrong duration.
trigger_input: Two helos: A at 100 m demanded 100 m, B at 0 m demanded 400 m, stepped alternately; A's doTurn sees demHeight=400 from B's previous doTurn2 and enters the climb branch although its own demanded height equals its current height.
suggested_fix: Use demStatus.getHeight() (clamped as in doTurn2) at L1039, and make TurnAlgorithm state local to doTurn2 (or one instance per participant) instead of a static shared instance.
llm_value: Requires tracking which field is written where and the static sharing of the object across participants.

title: Participant ids from unseeded java.util.Random make runs non-reproducible and...
description: generateInt uses a static 'new java.util.Random()' (L24) with no seed, independent of RandomGenerator.seed(). Ids are keys of CoreScenario's HashMaps (CoreScenario L495-L505) whose iteration order drives the order in which participants decide, move and detect (CoreScenario L1394-L1423) and therefore the order in which RandomGenerator draws are consumed. Even with a RandomSeed in the control file, two runs of the same scenario can produce different outcomes. Ids are drawn from only 1,000,000 values; a collision silently replaces the earlier participant (CoreScenario L707-L711 only prints 'DUPLICATE ENTITY').
trigger_input: Run the same Monte-Carlo scenario twice with RandomSeed=42 and participants created through createNewParticipant/ParticipantVariance; per-run detection times differ.
suggested_fix: Draw ids from RandomGenerator (seeded) or a monotonically increasing counter; make CoreScenario reject duplicate ids or use LinkedHashMap to fix stepping order.
llm_value: Requires tracing how ids affect HashMap order and downstream RNG consumption.

title: createNewRandomisedPermutations loops forever when MaxPerms cannot be satisfied
description: The generation loop 'while (counter < _numPerms)' (L637) rejects permutations whose hash already appears MaxPerms times, but the only escape check 'attempts > 2 * _numPerms' merely prints a message (L696-L698) and never breaks. A control file whose variance space has fewer than Number/MaxPerms distinct combinations hangs the generator (and the GUI/command-line runner) indefinitely. Same code duplicated in createNewRandomisedPermutationsOld (L731, L790).
trigger_input: Control file with a single Choice of 2 values, Number=3, MaxPerms=1.
suggested_fix: Break out of the loop (and return an error) when attempts exceed the limit.
llm_value: grep-able once you know to look, but recognising the missing break needs reading.

title: Random course and random location use Math.random(), bypassing the seeded Ran...
description: applyRandomCourse sets Course = Math.random()*360 (L290) and applyDistributionArea calls WorldArea.getRandomLocation() (L244), which itself uses Math.random() (MWC/GenericData/WorldArea.java L717-L719). ScenarioGenerator.doScenarioGeneration seeds only RandomGenerator (ScenarioGenerator L893-L895), so generated scenario sets are not reproducible from the RandomSeed attribute. Also 'isMonte == ""' (L346) is a string reference comparison.
trigger_input: Control file with RandomSeed=7 and a ParticipantVariance with RandomCourse=true or inRandomLocations=true; regenerate twice and diff the output scenario files.
suggested_fix: Use RandomGenerator.nextRandom() for course and add a seeded variant of WorldArea.getRandomLocation (or generate lat/long here with RandomGenerator); use isEmpty().
llm_value: Requires knowing which RNG the seed applies to; grep for Math.random finds candidates but not the seed linkage.

title: Dropped file sniffed with unhardened DocumentBuilder and parsed as a URI
description: getFirstNodeName() fully parses any file dropped onto the scenario controller with a default DocumentBuilderFactory (entities and DTDs enabled) just to read the root element name; it also passes the raw path to builder.parse(String), which treats it as a URI, so paths containing '#' or '%' fail. SAXException is not caught and propagates as Exception.
trigger_input: Drop a control file containing a DOCTYPE with an external entity onto the Scenario Controller view
suggested_fix: Harden the factory (secure processing, disallow-doctype-decl) and parse via new File(path) or a FileInputStream; consider a streaming StAX peek that stops at the first START_ELEMENT.
llm_value: grep-able

title: Control-file load failure leaves _scenarioController null and is then derefer...
description: importThisControlFile() failures are caught and logged but execution continues to _scenarioController.observerList and isRelativePath(tgtDir), so a malformed control file produces an NPE in the UI thread rather than an error message; importThisControlFile also returns null when the file has no ScenarioController element, and outputDirectory is null when the attribute is absent (NPE in isRelativePath at thePath.length()). The controlType dispatch at L534-L535 compares Strings with == and relies on interning.
trigger_input: Drop an .xml control file with a syntax error, or one lacking OutputDirectory, onto the Multi Scenario view
suggested_fix: Return after logging when import fails or the container/directory is null; use equals() for the type comparison.
llm_value: Needs following the caught-exception path into the following statements.

title: Generated XML re-encoded through the platform default charset
description: writeToString() serialises with a Transformer (UTF-8 output by default) into a ByteArrayOutputStream and then calls bos.toString() (platform charset); writeTheseToFile() writes the resulting String with FileWriter (platform charset again). On a non-UTF-8 default locale any non-ASCII text in the scenario is corrupted while the file still declares encoding="UTF-8", so the generated scenarios fail to parse or contain mojibake.
trigger_input: Template with participant name containing an accented character, generated on a Windows cp1252 machine
suggested_fix: Use bos.toString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8) and write with an OutputStreamWriter in UTF-8 (or stream the Transformer directly to the file).
llm_value: grep-able

title: readDocumentFrom returns null on parse failure; callers dereference it
description: readDocumentFrom(InputSource) catches SAXException/IOException, prints the stack trace and returns null; readDocumentFrom(InputStream) does the same for IOException. validateThisDocument() then calls getIt.getNodeType() on the null (NPE instead of the intended error string) and contains the no-op 'scrapNodeType = scrapNodeType++'. Other callers of readDocumentFrom in the Monte Carlo code receive null documents on malformed input.
trigger_input: Run scenario generation with a scenario template that is not well-formed XML
suggested_fix: Let the exceptions propagate (or wrap them in a checked ImportException) and remove the dead scrapNodeType code.
llm_value: grep-able

title: Unauthenticated ServerSocket deserializes first inbound connection (double re...
description: startListener binds a ServerSocket on all interfaces in a configurable port range (L252-L254), accepts one connection from anyone (L269), wraps it in an unfiltered ObjectInputStream, readObject()s a MarshalledObject and then calls mo.get() which deserializes a second attacker-controlled payload (L270-L273). The result is stored as the RMI service reference without checking it implements _serviceInterface. No callers of RMIDiscovery/RMILookup exist in the repository, so this is dead code, but it is shipped in the ASSET bundle. RuntimeExceptions from readObject also escape the thread (only IOException/ClassNotFoundException are caught, L277-L280).
trigger_input: While lookup() is running, an attacker on the LAN connects to the advertised port and sends a serialized gadget/SerialDOS stream (the multicast request at L302 even tells them the port).
suggested_fix: Remove the jip RMI discovery package, or if kept, apply ObjectInputFilter, verify the returned Remote is an instance of _serviceInterface, and bind to loopback or authenticate peers.
llm_value: Grep finds ObjectInputStream but the double-deserialization via MarshalledObject.get and the accept-from-anyone design need reading.

title: Truncated/malformed PDUs are returned half-initialised because unmarshal swal...
description: createPdu(byte[]) calls aPdu.unmarshal(dis) and returns aPdu unconditionally (L116-L237). Every edu.nps.moves.dis unmarshal() (e.g. EntityStatePdu L570-L596, DataPdu L237-L260, VariableDatum) wraps parsing in `catch (Exception e) { System.out.println(e); }`, so an EOFException from a short datagram leaves fields at their defaults (location 0,0,0, timestamp 0, empty lists) and the PDU is still dispatched to fix/event listeners as valid data. createPdu also ignores DatagramPacket.getLength() and pduLength (Pdu.unmarshal L370) so trailing buffer bytes are parsed as payload. The ByteBuffer variant at L257 indexes PduType.lookup without the bounds guard used at L97-L101 (unused in Debrief).
trigger_input: A 20-byte datagram with PDU type 1 (EntityState): a fix at lat/lon 0,0 time 0 is added to the live plot.
suggested_fix: Have unmarshal propagate a checked exception (or return false) and drop PDUs that fail to parse; pass packet.getLength() into the DataInputStream and validate pduLength against it.
llm_value: Needs understanding of how generated open-dis code and the factory interact; a grep for empty catch blocks finds thousands of hits.

title: Child simulator stderr never drained; output pump drops lines and spins
description: run() launches the external simulator (L55) but only reads stdout (L57); nothing consumes getErrorStream(), so a simulator writing more than the OS pipe buffer to stderr blocks forever. The pump thread (L59-L92) reads one line, then tests exitValue() and terminates as soon as the process has exited, discarding any remaining buffered stdout lines; if the child closes stdout while still running, readLine() returns null immediately and the loop busy-spins at 100% CPU. stop() nulls oThread without signalling _terminated (L106-L117).
trigger_input: Configure a simulator script that prints a long stack trace to stderr, or one that closes stdout and keeps running.
suggested_fix: Use ProcessBuilder.redirectErrorStream(true), loop `while ((line = readLine()) != null)` (EOF is the termination signal), and make _terminated volatile/set it in stop().
llm_value: Standard Process-handling pitfalls, but the line-dropping and spin behaviour require reading the loop logic.

title: c3p0 0.9.5.5 / mchange-commons-java 0.2.20 flagged by four 2026 advisories
description: OSV reports CVE-2026-27830 (HIGH) and CVE-2026-55223 for com.mchange:c3p0 0.9.5.5 and CVE-2026-27727 / CVE-2026-55153 (HIGH) for com.mchange:mchange-commons-java 0.2.20; c3p0 has had no release since 2019. ComboPooledDataSource is instantiated directly (PostgresDatabaseConnection L147, SqliteDatabaseConnection L144) for every Pepys connection. Exploitability in Debrief could not be assessed here because the advisory texts were not fetched; marked Low confidence on impact.
trigger_input: Depends on advisory details; Pepys connects with attacker-influenced configuration.
suggested_fix: Read the four advisories; replace c3p0 with HikariCP (actively maintained, ~150 KB) or drop pooling since Pepys opens a single connection.
llm_value: grep-able

title: pgjdbc 42.2.11 (8 CVEs) used for Pepys database import
description: postgresql-42.2.11 (Mar 2020) is affected by CVE-2020-13692 (XXE in PgSQLXML when reading XML columns from a hostile server), CVE-2022-21724 (arbitrary class instantiation from connection properties), CVE-2022-31197 (SQL injection in ResultSet.refreshRow), CVE-2022-41946 (world-readable temp files for large prepared-statement parameters), CVE-2024-1597 (SQL injection when preferQueryMode=simple) and CVE-2026-42198. PostgresDatabaseConnection.initialize L140-153 builds the JDBC URL and user/password from the Pepys configuration file the analyst loads, so a malicious config or server controls the driver; simple query mode is not enabled, so CVE-2024-1597 does not apply.
trigger_input: A shared Pepys .ini pointing at an attacker-run PostgreSQL that returns crafted XML/refreshRow responses; or CVE-2022-41946 temp-file exposure on multi-user hosts.
suggested_fix: Upgrade to org.postgresql:postgresql 42.7.x (drop-in) and set ssl=true by default instead of the hard-coded "ssl","false" at L145.
llm_value: grep-able for version; reachability needed reading the config-driven connection code.

title: sqlite-jdbc 3.30.1 (CVE-2023-32697) + load_extension on user-supplied DBs
description: sqlite-jdbc before 3.41.2.2 allows code execution through a crafted JDBC URL (CVE-2023-32697, native library written to a predictable temp path) and the bundled SQLite 3.30.1 (2019) lacks four years of upstream fixes. SqliteDatabaseConnection.initialize L141-142 additionally calls SQLiteConfig.enableLoadExtension(true) before opening whichever .sqlite file the Pepys configuration names (L149-158), so any SQL executed against a hostile database that defines views/triggers invoking load_extension() loads native code.
trigger_input: A shared Pepys SQLite export whose 'States' view is redefined as SELECT load_extension('\\evil\share\x.dll').
suggested_fix: Upgrade to org.xerial:sqlite-jdbc 3.46+, load SpatiaLite explicitly via a fixed path and turn enableLoadExtension back off after loading it.
llm_value: Needed to connect the driver CVE with the enableLoadExtension setting and the config-supplied file path.

title: Switch.decide uses elementAt(index-1) with default index 0 -> ArrayIndexOutOf...
description: _selectedActivity defaults to 0 (L136) while decide indexes _myDecisions.elementAt(getIndex()-1) (L167); a Switch behaviour without an explicit Index (or with Index larger than the number of children) crashes the scenario step with ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException, which CoreScenario does not catch for decisions.
trigger_input: Scenario XML with a <Switch> behaviour lacking the Index attribute or with fewer children than Index.
suggested_fix: Validate index range in decide (return null / log) and default to 1.
llm_value: grep-able

title: Copy constructor leaves _thePeriod null; nearest/most-recent lookups NPE or t...
description: DetectionList(Collection) (L192-L194) does not initialise _thePeriod, so add()/extend()/getTimeCoverage() on such a list NPE (L207, L222). SensorList.detects builds one at L248. getNearestDetection filters on getEstimatedRange()!=null but the comparator dereferences getRange() (L398-L400), which is null for bearing-only sensors (canProduceRange=false) whose getEstimatedRange is a constant (BroadbandSensor L218-L220) -> NPE; getBestDetection/getMostRecentDetection call ss.last() on an empty set (L257, L378) -> NoSuchElementException, and their TreeSets collapse equal-key events so the returned element is arbitrary.
trigger_input: Decision behaviour calling detections.getNearestDetection() with two bearing-only broadband contacts.
suggested_fix: Initialise _thePeriod in the copy constructor; compare on getEstimatedRange(); return null for empty lists.
llm_value: Requires cross-checking filter vs comparator field.

title: Propagation loss mixes metres and yards: absorption dB/kyd applied to km, spr...
description: getLossBetween converts range with Degs2m (metres) into a variable named rng_yds (L60) and then applies ABSORPTION_COEFFICIENT_DB_PER_KY (dB per kiloyard) to rng_yds/1000 (L71-L74), i.e. per kilometre; the 20*log10 spreading term is also referenced to 1 m instead of 1 yd. Absorption is under-estimated by ~9% and spreading offset by 0.78 dB, shifting every passive/active detection range in the environment model.
trigger_input: Target at 20 kyd (18288 m): code returns 20log10(18288)+0.08*18.288=86.7 dB; the intended yards formula gives 20log10(20000)+0.08*20=87.6 dB.
suggested_fix: Use Conversions.Degs2Yds(rng_degs) for rng_yds (or rename and change the coefficient to dB/km consistently).
llm_value: Requires matching the variable/constant units against the conversion actually called.

title: Bearing noise drawn from a fresh unseeded java.util.Random on every detection
description: When ApplyNoise is set, detectThis creates 'new Random()' per detection (L517) and adds MEAN + nextGaussian()*STANDARD_DEVIATION. The noise ignores RandomGenerator.seed(), so noisy-bearing runs are not reproducible; creating a Random per call is also needlessly slow.
trigger_input: Cookie-cutter sensor with ApplyNoise=true under a seeded Monte-Carlo run: bearings differ between repeated runs.
suggested_fix: Use RandomGenerator.generateNormalValue(STANDARD_DEVIATION) + MEAN.
llm_value: grep-able

title: Detection-period gating applies only once per target: _timesGained never clea...
description: When a doublet has a Period, the first time a target comes in range its gain time is recorded (L490) and detection suppressed until 'required' elapses. The removal on losing contact is commented out (L469-L473) and restart() is not overridden, so once a target has ever been in range, all later regains (and all subsequent Monte-Carlo restarts of the same scenario object) detect instantly. The intended 'time-to-gain' behaviour silently degrades after the first contact.
trigger_input: Cookie sensor with Period=5 min; target enters range, leaves, re-enters: second entry is detected at the first scan.
suggested_fix: Remove the target's entry from _timesGained when not detected; clear _timesGained in an overridden restart().
llm_value: Requires understanding intended state machine; commented-out line is a hint.

title: Sensor-offset back-track grows without bound: a fix is appended for every tar...
description: getHostLocationFor is called from detectThis for every candidate target each scan; when a sensor offset is set it appends a new FixWrapper to _backTrack every call (L472-L476) and never trims it, so a long run with N targets adds N fixes per step (many at identical times) and memory/lookup cost grows linearly for the whole scenario; restart only clears it between runs (L657-L660).
trigger_input: Towed-array sensor with SensorOffset set, 20 targets, 1 s step, 12 h run: ~860k fixes retained in one TrackWrapper.
suggested_fix: Add one fix per (participant,time) and prune fixes older than the array length + margin.
llm_value: Requires understanding call frequency of the method.

title: Active sonar only 'detects' targets that radiate passive noise and omits targ...
description: canDetectThisType returns other.radiatesThisNoise(BROADBAND_PASSIVE) (L167-L171), so a silent target (no BroadbandRadNoise) is never candidate for active detection; getTgtNoise returns the sensor's own source level (L236-L240) with no target-strength term, so the active sonar equation is SL - 2TL - NL + DI - DT with TS fixed at 0 dB and all targets equally reflective. Combined with SensorList.getRadiatedNoiseFor the transmission also does not count as radiated noise for passive listeners (medium mismatch).
trigger_input: Scenario with an ActiveBroadbandSensor and a target without any radiated-noise characteristics: no detections ever.
suggested_fix: Gate on the target having reflected characteristics (Medium.reflectedEnergyFor) and add a TS term from RadiatedCharacteristics.reflectedEnergyFor.
llm_value: Requires sonar-equation knowledge.

title: Sonar equation subtracts own-ship and background noise separately in dB inste...
description: detectThis computes fom = tgtNoise - (osNoise - di) - rd - bkNoise (L177). Two noise levels in dB cannot be subtracted independently: the noise term should be the power sum NL = 10log10(10^(os/10)+10^(bk/10)). With realistic values (os 60 dB, bk 35 dB) the code removes 95 dB where the physics removes ~60 dB, so signal excess is under-estimated by tens of dB whenever self noise is non-zero. (Today this is masked because CoreParticipant.getSelfNoiseFor returns 0; fixing that bug exposes this one.) CoreSensor.SensorUtils.powerSum (CoreSensor L112) exists but is unused here.
trigger_input: BroadbandSensor host with SelfNoise 60 dB, environment bkgnd 35 dB, target 120 dB at short range: code gives SE = 120-(60-34)-2-35-loss = 57-loss; correct SE = 120-(60.01-34)-2-loss = 92-loss.
suggested_fix: Replace '- (osNoise - di) - rd - bkNoise' with '- (SensorUtils.powerSum(osNoise, bkNoise) - di) - rd'.
llm_value: Requires domain knowledge of the passive sonar equation; not greppable.

title: Ambiguous-bearing selection compares a relative bearing with an absolute cour...
description: RelBrg = bearing - course is not wrapped to +/-180 (L185-L186). handleAmbiguousBearing then decides which of the two bearings is 'true' with 'if (RelBrg < crse)' (L283), comparing a relative bearing (-360..360) against an absolute course (0..360); the outcome is arbitrary and flips as the host turns through north, swapping bearing and ambiguous bearing in DetectionEvent and thus in every downstream TMA/observer output. The wrap loop also uses '> 360' instead of '>= 360' (L277).
trigger_input: Towed-array (setAmbiguous(true)) host on course 350 with a target at true bearing 010: RelBrg=-340, crse=350, so the true bearing is stored as the ambiguous one; on course 010 with target at 350 the assignment inverts.
suggested_fix: Normalise RelBrg to (-180,180] once; choose the primary bearing by a stable rule (e.g. always store the true bearing in setBearing and mirror in setAmbiguousBearing) rather than comparing relative to absolute.
llm_value: Requires reasoning about angular reference frames.

title: Active-sonar source levels and vessel radiated noise added arithmetically in dB
description: getRadiatedNoiseFor sums source levels of all working active sensors with 'res += at.getSourceLevel()' (L366) and CoreParticipant.getRadiatedNoiseFor adds that to the vessel level ('vesselRadiated + sensorRadiated', CoreParticipant L648). Adding decibels linearly (e.g. 120 dB + 200 dB = 320 dB) massively over-states the target's radiated level, so any passive sensor 'hears' a pinging ship at absurd ranges. Additionally the medium filter at L359 never matches: active sensors report BROADBAND_ACTIVE (5) while passive queries ask for BROADBAND_PASSIVE (0), whereas radiatesThisMedium (L451-L466) ignores the medium entirely, so the two methods disagree about whether a pinging vessel radiates.
trigger_input: Surface ship with BroadbandRadNoise 120 dB and a working ActiveBroadbandSensor SL 200 dB; passive detector queries radiated noise for BROADBAND_PASSIVE.
suggested_fix: Combine levels with SensorUtils.powerSum; decide consistently which medium an active transmission pollutes and use the same test in getRadiatedNoiseFor and radiatesThisMedium.
llm_value: Needs dB domain knowledge and cross-class tracing of medium constants.

title: Demanded sensor states after the first are never applied; restart() casts the...
description: doMovement creates one iterator over the sensors (L426) outside the loop over demanded sensor states (L435-L445); after the first DemandedSensorStatus exhausts it, later states are silently ignored, so a decision that switches two sensors only switches one. restart() copies _participantDetectedListeners while casting it to Vector<ParticipantDecidedListener> (L797-L803), producing ClassCastException when a detected-only listener is iterated as a decided listener (and NPE when only decided listeners are registered).
trigger_input: Decision model issuing DemandedStatus with two DemandedSensorStatus entries (e.g. ChangeSensorLineUp for two mediums); scenario restart with a DetectionObserver attached but no decided listener.
suggested_fix: Create the sensor iterator inside the per-state loop; clone _participantDecidedListeners at L797.
llm_value: Copy-paste bugs visible only by reading the loop structure.

title: Genes share one XMLVarianceList (clone returns this); createRandom mutates it...
description: Gene relies on XMLVarianceList.clone() and XMLVariance.clone(), but both return 'this' (XMLVarianceList L92-L97, XMLVariance L541-L546). Every Gene therefore aliases the same chromosome list; createRandom iterates that list while adding to it (L341-L349) which throws ConcurrentModificationException on a Vector iterator, and mergeWith mutates the shared objects. compareTo returns -1 for distinct genes of equal fitness (L322-L333), violating antisymmetry for the TreeSets in GeneticAlgorithm; equals casts without instanceof (L362) and hashCode is not overridden. getDocument() always returns null because _newDocument is a final null field (L274).
trigger_input: Run GeneticAlgorithm.generate() with a population>1 on any variance file (only reachable from org.mwc.asset.test AllTests / GUI factory).
suggested_fix: Implement real deep clones; randomise in place instead of appending; make compareTo consistent (compare fitness then identity); implement hashCode.
llm_value: Requires following clone() into the callee to see it is a no-op.

title: promote() sorts with a broken comparator and indexes past the array; sort() d...
description: promote's Comparator returns '1 - compareTo' (L358): equal -> 1, greater -> 0, less -> 2, so it is not a valid ordering (TimSort may throw IllegalArgumentException) and the 'descending' sort is wrong; the trim loop then reads list[ii] for ii<_stars_size without checking list.length (L364-L365) and throws ArrayIndexOutOfBounds when fewer genes than stars exist. In step(), lowScoresHigh negates scores (L484-L485) so a legitimate score of 1.0 becomes -1.0 == INVALID_SCORE and is silently discarded by sort() (L435). TotalRunner starts from score=-1 so the product is negated (L142). _currentGene is a static shared field (L156).
trigger_input: GA with stars_size=5 and 3 valid genes, or any runner returning exactly 1.0 with lowScoresHigh=true.
suggested_fix: Use Collections.reverseOrder()/negated compareTo, bound the trim loop by list.length, and use a separate 'valid' flag instead of the -1 sentinel.
llm_value: Requires reasoning about comparator contracts and sentinel collisions.

title: Target count never reset across restarts and never decremented, skewing propo...
description: _numTargets is only populated when it is 0 (L236) and incremented on every newParticipant matching the target type (L224), but is never reset in performSetupProcessing/restart and never decremented in participantRemoved. In a multi-run (restart) session any target-type participant created mid-run (e.g. launched weapons or buoys matching the type) inflates the denominator permanently, so getProportionDetected() and the batch statistic drift downward run after run.
trigger_input: Scenario restarted 10 times where a target-type participant is created during each run: denominator grows by one each restart.
suggested_fix: Reset _numTargets in performSetupProcessing (recount from the scenario) and decrement in participantRemoved.
llm_value: Requires reasoning about observer lifecycle across restarts.

title: Watch/target lists captured only at setup: participants created during the ru...
description: performSetupProcessing snapshots matching participants into _watchVessels/_targetVessels (L575-L598) and step() only iterates those (L665-L680). The observer does not implement ParticipantsChangedListener, so a torpedo/weapon or sensor buoy created via scenario.createParticipant during the run (LaunchWeapon L939, LaunchSensor L229) is never range-checked, and StopOnProximityObserver never stops a scenario on a launched weapon's closest approach.
trigger_input: StopOnProximityObserver with WatchType=TORPEDO against a target when the torpedo is launched by a LaunchWeapon behaviour after start.
suggested_fix: Register as ParticipantsChangedListener and add/remove from the lists on newParticipant/participantRemoved.
llm_value: Requires knowing how weapons enter the scenario.

title: Batch result converts a participant count with Degs2m and labels it 'range (m...
description: performCloseProcessing submits '(int) Conversions.Degs2m(_myScore)' (L295) but _myScore is the number of removed participants (incremented in ditchThese L127), copied from ProximityObserver where the score is a range in degrees; the batch collator therefore records 111,120 per removed participant under the unit label 'range (metres)' (L335). restart() also resets _myScore to -1 (L343) whereas setup/close use 0, so the first removal after a restart is counted as 0.
trigger_input: Monte-Carlo run with RemoveInAreaObserver batch collation (AVERAGE): output shows 222240 for two removed vessels.
suggested_fix: Submit _myScore directly with units 'participants'; reset to 0 in restart().
llm_value: Requires recognising a copy-paste from a sibling class with different semantics.

title: LocationOffset ignores RandomModel and fails to remove long/relative location...
description: newPermutation always draws bearing and range uniformly (L204-L205) regardless of the RandomModel attribute read at L100 (a uniform range gives a centre-heavy density, and a Normal model is silently ignored). execute() tries to remove an existing location child but both branches test 'shortLocation' (L138-L144), so a longLocation or relativeLocation child is kept alongside the inserted shortLocation; which one the scenario reader honours is undefined.
trigger_input: Variance with <LocationOffset RandomModel="Normal"> applied to a participant whose Location is given as longLocation.
suggested_fix: Copy the three-way removal from LocationArea.execute (L123-L136) and honour _myRandomModel when drawing range/bearing.
llm_value: Copy-paste duplicate condition is visible on reading; the ignored field needs data-flow tracing.

title: Stepped Range never generates its max value; step larger than range collapses...
description: getNextRandom with a step computes num_steps=(int)((max-min)/step) and rnd in [0,num_steps-1], so the value max is unreachable (L280-L283). For min=0,max=90,step=30 only 0,30,60 are ever produced; when step>(max-min) num_steps is 0 and every permutation is min. Also step=0 divides by zero (Infinity cast to int) giving garbage. Uniform, non-stepped ranges are fine.
trigger_input: Variance attribute <Range min="0" max="90" step="30"/> with Number=1000: value 90 never appears.
suggested_fix: Use num_steps = (int)Math.round((max-min)/step)+1 (guard step<=0) so both ends are inclusive.
llm_value: Requires evaluating integer truncation semantics.

title: merge() perturbation is always negative: value drifts to min during GA crossover
description: merge computes var_2 = 2*0.05*(max-min) and adds '(var_2)*rand - (var_2)' (L319-L322), i.e. a perturbation uniformly in [-var_2, 0] instead of the intended symmetric [-variance, +variance]. Every crossover pushes the chromosome downward until clamped at min (L325-L326), biasing the genetic search.
trigger_input: Any GA run (GeneticAlgorithm.mutate -> Gene.mergeWith -> XMLRange.merge) with a Range chromosome; average of merged values decreases monotonically.
suggested_fix: Use '_currentValue += var_2 * rand - variance;'.
llm_value: Requires arithmetic reasoning about the intended distribution.

title: Scenario export always throws after building the document; importer shares st...
description: exportThis() constructs the full DOM and then unconditionally throws UnsupportedOperationException('Xerces DOM export deprecated'), so any caller believes export is available but it never writes anything. importParticipant() communicates its result through the static field _tempPart, so concurrent participant imports overwrite each other.
trigger_input: Any call to ASSETReaderWriter.exportThis(scenario, layer, os)
suggested_fix: Replace the throw with the Transformer-based serialisation used elsewhere (DebriefXMLReaderWriter.outputContent) and return the participant via a local holder.
llm_value: grep-able

description: processThisFile() parses the first entry of each zip in a hard-coded directory with SAXParserFactory.newInstance().newSAXParser() (no hardening), and the handler calls System.exit(1) on any SQLException. It is a developer utility with a hard-coded path so impact is low, but it is still an XXE sink on attacker-supplied KMZ.

title: Scenario control REST API bound on all interfaces with no authentication
description: go() starts a Restlet Component listening on HTTP 8080 on every interface with the FILE client protocol enabled (L33-L37); GuestServer does the same on 8081 (GuestServer L36-L38). The routed handlers accept PUT/POST that change scenario state and participants' demanded status (router L66-L80; DemStatusHandler L27-L30, ScenarioStateHandler L25-L28) with no authentication, authorization or origin check, and ASSETResource parses path ids with Integer.parseInt without catching NumberFormatException (ASSETResource L26-L38). Real type: missing authentication on a network control surface. Experimental plugin, standalone main().

suggested_fix: Bind to 127.0.0.1 by default, add a ChallengeAuthenticator or token check, drop Protocol.FILE, and validate ids.

title: Hard-coded public DB host, user and password constant in ASSET observer
description: The observer connects to a hard-coded public IPv4 address (86.134.91.5:5432/gnd) as user 'dev' with a compile-time password constant (currently the placeholder 'MISSING'). Credentials and endpoint are baked into shipped bytecode; the pattern invites a real password being committed, and the observer will silently fail against the stale host.
trigger_input: Enable the RecordStatusToDB observer in an ASSET scenario: it attempts to connect to the hard-coded host with the constant credentials.
suggested_fix: Move host/user/password to observer configuration (scenario XML attribute or preference) with no default password; or remove the dead observer.
llm_value: grep-able

title: Multicast request dictates reply port; service stub is serialized to any peer
description: run() parses an unauthenticated multicast datagram (L193-L210), takes the reply port from the packet, opens a TCP connection to the sender at that port and writes a MarshalledObject of the live RMI service (L233-L236). Any host in the multicast group can harvest the service stub or make the lookup thread connect to arbitrary ports on itself. Integer.parseInt at L208 is outside the try at L201-L206 so a non-numeric port kills the listener thread (uncaught NumberFormatException propagates to L252 and the loop exits). Dead code (no callers).
trigger_input: Datagram `<header><delim>abc<delim>iface<delim>ANY` sent to the jip multicast group: listener thread terminates permanently.
suggested_fix: Remove the package, or validate port range, catch NumberFormatException inside the loop and restrict replies to the source address of trusted peers.
llm_value: Control-flow reading needed to see parseInt sits outside the protective try block.

title: Toy HTTP jar server serves any *.jar/*.class path including ../ traversal
description: serviceRequest extracts the path from the request line and opens `new File(fileName)` (L70-L88) with only a suffix check (L81-L83); '../' segments and absolute paths are not rejected, so any .jar or .class readable by the process anywhere on disk is served over the network. It also NPEs on an empty request (ln null at L72) and never limits concurrent threads. Developer utility with its own main(), not wired into the product.
trigger_input: GET /../../../../usr/lib/jvm/.../rt.jar HTTP/1.0 against the listening port.
suggested_fix: Delete the class, or canonicalize the path and require it to start with the serving directory.
llm_value: grep-able

title: Codehaus jackson-mapper-asl 1.9.4 (abandoned 2013) parses network JSON

GNDManager's ESearch (L181-L184) and TrackStoreWrapper (L109) use it to parse responses from a user-configured Elasticsearch/CouchDB endpoint, i.e. remote data. No default typing is enabled so the deserialization CVE is not directly reachable.

title: _entityNames guard uses Long key against Integer-keyed map, so it never matches
description: _entityNames is Map<Integer,String> (L52) but the name-listener checks `_entityNames.get(senderId)` with a long parameter (L62, L66), which autoboxes to Long and never equals an Integer key; the guard is therefore always true and the name is re-extracted/overwritten on every launch/new-track event, defeating the 'first name wins' intent and letting a later DETECTION message rename an entity.
trigger_input: Two EventReport PDUs for the same entity: 'Entity 1 called Alpha has been created' then 'DETECTION E4-5' -> entity is renamed to E4-5.
suggested_fix: Cast senderId to int before the get(), or key the map by Long consistently.
llm_value: Autoboxing mismatch is invisible to grep; needs type reasoning.

title: Listener state shared across UI and network threads without synchronization
description: _gen is a plain ArrayList iterated on the receive thread (L268-L272) while addListener (L94-L96) may be called from the UI thread (ConcurrentModificationException); _running (L77) is a non-volatile boolean set by detach() on another thread; _senderSocket/_theAddress/_thePort are assigned on the attach() worker thread (L117-L122) but sendPause/sendPlay/sendStop use them from the UI thread (L196-L199) giving an NPE if the user presses Pause before attach's thread has run; _curExercise is written on the receive thread and read on the UI thread.
trigger_input: Click Launch then immediately Pause in the DIS Listener view before the multicast socket is created; or add a listener while PDUs are arriving.
suggested_fix: Use CopyOnWriteArrayList for _gen, mark _running/_curExercise volatile, create sockets synchronously in attach() (or guard sendPDU against null socket).
llm_value: Requires tracing which thread runs each method.

title: Kryo/KryoNet 1.04 (2010) network deserialisation in ASSET multiplayer

Kryo 1.x is 15 years old and unsupported; Network.register (L249-260) does register the message classes explicitly, which prevents arbitrary-class instantiation, so exposure is limited to malformed-buffer crashes on the ASSET server port. Six further duplicate jars under libs/kryonet-1.04/kryonet/{lib,build} and onejar/ are unreferenced dead weight. Not part of the Debrief product.
trigger_input: Malformed packet to a running ASSET NetCore server.
suggested_fix: Upgrade to Kryo 5.x/KryoNet fork or replace with a simple JSON-over-TCP protocol; delete the duplicate jar copies.
